description: This file implements command authorization logic for an auto-reply system, including provider resolution, owner and sender validation, and command permission checks.

methods.name: resolveProviderFromContext
methods.description: Resolves the provider ID from message context, considering explicit channels and inferred providers.

methods.name: probeInferredProviders
methods.description: Probes and lists inferred providers based on available channel plugins.

methods.name: formatAllowFromList
methods.description: Formats a list of 'allowFrom' entries, applying plugin-specific formatting if available.

methods.name: normalizeAllowFromEntry
methods.description: Normalizes a single 'allowFrom' entry into a list of strings.

methods.name: resolveProviderAllowFrom
methods.description: Resolves the 'allowFrom' list for a provider, with fallback and error handling.

methods.name: describeAllowFromResolutionError
methods.description: Provides a string description for errors encountered during 'allowFrom' resolution.

methods.name: resolveOwnerAllowFromList
methods.description: Resolves the owner allowFrom list, filtering and formatting entries.

methods.name: resolveCommandsAllowFromList
methods.description: Resolves the commands.allowFrom list for a specific provider, with fallback to global list.

methods.name: isConversationLikeIdentity
methods.description: Checks if a string resembles a conversation identity (e.g., group, channel).

methods.name: shouldUseFromAsSenderFallback
methods.description: Determines if 'from' should be used as a sender fallback based on chat type and identity.

methods.name: resolveSenderCandidates
methods.description: Generates a list of sender candidates based on context and plugin preferences.

methods.name: resolveFallbackAllowFrom
methods.description: Resolves fallback 'allowFrom' list from channel and account configurations.

methods.name: resolveFallbackDefaultAccountConfig
methods.description: Resolves default account configuration for a channel.

methods.name: resolveCommandAuthorization
methods.description: Main function that resolves and returns command authorization details based on context, config, and command status.
